![Beaches in Koh Tao | Black Turtle Dive](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07282124-1672-0139-0000-10cbcdcfdafb:24)

Koh Tao features stunning tropical shores, with the top spots being [Sairee Beach](https://goodtimethailand.com/koh-tao-best-beaches/) for activity and sunsets, [Shark Bay](https://www.benothinglike.com/post/best-beaches-on-koh-tao-turtle-island?srsltid=AfmBOor9RKvdmyX_ErZbuZRuYcxl6-uVG5guv59DtLPlu7JTDODkrXwE) for marine life, and [Koh Nang Yuan](https://nomadphotographer.com/koh-taos-best-beaches/) for its unique sandbar.[](https://nomadphotographer.com/koh-taos-best-beaches/) [[1]](https://nomadphotographer.com/koh-taos-best-beaches/)[[2]](https://www.blackturtledive.com/koh-tao/beaches/)[[3]](https://www.benothinglike.com/post/best-beaches-on-koh-tao-turtle-island)

Main Beaches and Bays

- **Sairee Beach:** The longest stretch of sand (1.7 km) on the west coast; famous for sunsets, beach bars, and easy swimming.
- **Shark Bay (Thian Og):** A quiet southern bay with soft white sand where you can spot green sea turtles and reef sharks.
- **Ao Leuk:** A protected southeast cove with clear blue water and great coral reefs for snorkeling just meters from shore.
- **Freedom Beach:** A tiny, secluded southern cove shaded by low trees, offering peace away from the main towns.
- **Tanote Bay:** An east-coast bay known for deep blue water, vibrant marine life, and a large rock popular for cliff jumping.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g303910-Activities-c61-t52-Koh_Tao_Surat_Thani_Province.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g303910-Activities-c61-t52-Koh_Tao_Surat_Thani_Province.html)[[2]](https://www.baconismagic.ca/thailand/beaches-in-koh-tao/)[[3]](https://goodtimethailand.com/koh-tao-best-beaches/)[[4]](https://thousandtravelmiles.nl/en/thailand/beaches-koh-tao-thailand)[[5]](https://www.facebook.com/kohtaocompleteguide/videos/koh-taos-5-best-beaches-to-visit/1031944139513033/)

Day Trips and Islands

- **Koh Nang Yuan:** Three small islets connected by a famous white sandbar, located just off Koh Tao's northwest coast; ideal for a half-day trip and viewpoint hikes (100 THB entry fee).[](https://nomadphotographer.com/koh-taos-best-beaches/) [[1]](https://theboldpassport.com/best-beaches-in-koh-tao-top-10-ranked/)

If you're planning a trip, let me know:

- Are you looking for **snorkeling**, **nightlife** , or **relaxation**?
- Would you like advice on **entry fees** or **how to get around** the island?
